primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'U(t)': 'real usage at time t, dimensionless', 'T': 'trailing window duration, 30 days', '\\theta': 'threshold for listing eligibility, 0'}
primitives.assumptions: Usage data is collected via `usageSummary()` function; real usage must be nonzero over T.
primitives.breakdown_regime: U(t) = 0 for all t ∈ [t-T, t] implies invalid listing attempt.

layer2.mapping: The gate maps to a cumulative distribution function threshold test in GSI's Bayesian model; in GSE, it defines a pre-transition state in a finite-state automaton.

primitives.name: Traction Robustness Assurance
primitives.verbatim_quote: A listing built on zero real > usage has nothing to point to and risks overstating traction.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'R': 'risk of overstating traction, dimensionless', 'U_{\\text{eff}}': 'effective usage signal, dimensionless'}
primitives.assumptions: Overstating traction occurs when U_eff ≈ 0 but listing proceeds.
primitives.breakdown_regime: R → ∞ as U_eff → 0; listing is invalid under this regime.

layer2.mapping: Derived from usage validation; GSI applies confidence intervals to detect R; GSE enforces a rejection condition in its state machine.
layer2.telemetry: Observable: U_eff; Verification: statistical significance of U_eff > 0.
